name: Chain-link fabric, 2in mesh
description: Galvanized chain-link fabric, 2in mesh, 11.5 gauge, tied to galvanized framework. A child can climb 2in mesh, so it is not treated as a pool barrier; IRC AG105.2(6) and ISPSC 305 cap chain-link mesh at 2-1/4in, and many pool jurisdictions require 1-1/4in mini-mesh, so check locally.
source: Estimate 0.38 psf, between Midwest Air 48in x 50ft 11.5 ga 2-3/8in mesh at 72.1 lb (0.36 psf, eBay listing) and Kent 48in x 2in x 11 ga roll at 78.09 lb (0.39 psf); no maker spec for 2in 11.5 ga found. Mesh limit per IRC AG105.2(6) as summarized by local pool-barrier handouts (Hamilton, MA)

name: Chain-link fabric, mini-mesh (1-1/4in)
description: Galvanized chain-link fabric with 1-1/4in or smaller mesh, too small for a child's foothold: usable for a pool barrier at 4ft or taller with the bottom within 2in of grade.
source: Estimate: wire per area scales roughly with 1/mesh, so 2in 11.5 ga fabric at 0.38 psf x 2/1.25 = about 0.62 psf; no maker weight found

name: Chain-link fence pipe (galvanized)
description: Galvanized steel chain-link framework: 1-5/8in line posts, 2-3/8in terminal posts and 1-3/8in top rail. Retail residential pipe is light gauge; strength shown is the ASTM F1083 regular-grade minimum.
source: Wheatland F1083 Schedule 40 specifications: regular grade minimum yield 30,000 psi (high-strength grade and Allied Tube / Wheatland SS-20 / WT-20 pipe: 50,000 psi). E 29,000 ksi and density 490 pcf for carbon steel (rounded to 200,000 MPa and 7,850 kg/m³)

name: Aluminum pool fence panel
description: Powder-coated aluminum fence panel, 54in tall x 6ft wide, flat top and bottom, pickets under 4in apart for pool-code barriers; the gate must also be self-closing and self-latching.
source: Approximate: 1.3 lb per sq ft from an Ace Hardware Fortress Athens listing (product it applies to unclear), about 35 lb per 4.5 x 6ft panel; Fortress publishes no weight. Panel is 71in actual width (Fortress Athens brochure)

name: Aluminum fence post, 2x2in
description: 2 x 2in powder-coated aluminum fence post for aluminum panels and gates, set in concrete or on a surface mount.
source: Aluminum density 2,700 kg/m³ (6063 alloy about 0.0975 lb/in³); applied to the solid post bounding box this overstates the weight of a hollow post (about 0.55 lb/ft at 0.060in wall)

name: Frameless glass pool fence panel (12mm tempered)
description: Frameless 12mm (1/2in) tempered glass panel held by stainless spigots, for pool barriers at least 4ft tall. Gaps between panels must stay under 4in and the gate needs self-closing hinges and a magnetic latch.
source: Estimate: typical soda-lime float glass density about 2,500 kg/m³ (12mm = 30 kg/m², 6.1 psf); no maker figure retrieved

name: Gate hinges (pair)
description: A pair of galvanized or black steel strap or T-hinges for a wood or metal gate. Not self-closing, so not for pool gates.
source: Estimate: about 1.5 lb for a pair of 8in heavy strap hinges over an 8 x 4 x 1in box (no maker weight found)

name: Self-closing gate hinges (pair)
description: Adjustable self-closing gate hinges (D&D TruClose class) that swing a pool gate shut from any open position. Regular TruClose is rated for gates up to 66 lb, heavy duty to 154 lb.
source: D&D Technologies TruClose: Regular self-closes gates up to 66 lb (30 kg), Heavy Duty up to 154 lb (70 kg) (D&D store). Weight estimate: about 1 lb per pair over a 6 x 2.5 x 1.5in box

name: Gravity gate latch
description: Galvanized steel gravity latch that drops into its catch when the gate closes. Not a pool-gate latch: it can be reached from outside and is not self-latching from any position.
source: Estimate: about 0.75 lb over a 6 x 2 x 1.5in box (no maker weight found)

name: Magnetic pool gate latch
description: Magnetic self-latching pool gate latch (D&D MagnaLatch class), mounted with its release at least 54in above grade (or on the pool side) as pool barrier codes require.
source: D&D Technologies MagnaLatch Series 3 Top Pull and Vertical Pull (D&D store). Weight estimate: about 1.25 lb over an 8 x 3 x 2in box (no maker weight found)

name: Glass fence spigot
description: Stainless steel (2205 or 316) spigot clamping a 12mm glass panel, core-drilled into concrete or bolted on a base plate. Usually two per panel.
source: Estimate: about 3 lb (2205 stainless, 0.285 lb/in³, on a 50mm square body about 10in long including the core) over a 2 x 2 x 10in box
